'''Hukumina''' (also called '''Bambaa'''<ref name="Multitree">{{cite web|title=Hukumina|url-status=dead|archive-date=11 September 2019|publisher=[[Linguist List|LINGUIST List]]|access-date=6 November 2024|url=http://www.multitree.org/codes/huw.html|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190911091618/http://www.multitree.org/codes/huw.html}}</ref>) is an extinct [[Austronesian language]] recently spoken in the northwest of [[Buru Island]] in the [[Maluku Islands]] of eastern [[Indonesia]].  It had one native speaker in 1989.<ref>Grimes, "Buru (Masarete)", in Tsuchida, ed., 1995, ''Comparative Austronesian Dictionary''</ref>
